title: SHORT STORY WRITING
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 8 credits
description: Study and writing of the short story. (FA)
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 224 or 224H.
A minimum grade of D- is required in WR 224 and WR 224H.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. This section meets 50% in-person and 50% asynchronously online.
